processing: Yunnan large-leaf is withered, broken into small particles, often on crush-tear-curl (CTC) lines, then oxidised, dried and graded by particle size.
harvest_season: Dian Hong picking runs from about mid-March to mid-November, across spring, summer and autumn teas.
appearance_dry: Even, compact granules, dark with a brownish tinge.
appearance_wet: Fine particles of an even, bright red.
taste_profile: Strong, fresh and brisk with a clean aroma, built to carry milk and sugar.

brewing.notes: Western style or a tea bag, in boiling water. It brews fast, and past about 3 minutes it turns harsh. Takes milk well.

vintage_note: An everyday blending tea, not sold by vintage. Grades matter more than years: one major maker sorts its CTC into numbers 1 to 6 by particle size. Buy recent stock and use it within a year or two, since the small particles go flat quickly.
description:
Most Dian Hong you read about is whole-leaf gongfu with golden tips. This is the other half of the family: Yunnan black tea in small graded particles, built for strength and speed. Chinese sources split Dian Hong into exactly these two kinds, and also call this one graded Dian Hong.

The big Yunnan leaf gets cut small before oxidation, which exposes more of it and gives a strong, quick cup. At the Fengqing factory, the best-documented producer, the tea is sorted into six numbered particle sizes.

In the cup it is deep red, fresh and forceful. This is breakfast tea and teabag material rather than a tea for a small pot, so a mug and a few minutes will do. It holds up well to milk.

Buy it for what it is. Grade numbers refer to particle size. If you want to see what the same leaf does when kept whole, try a Dian Hong gongfu next.
history:
CTC, the cut-tear-curl method, is believed to have been invented in Assam around 1931. It reached Yunnan's flagship producer later: in 1992 the Dianhong factory at Fengqing brought in a complete CTC line from India and began making Feng brand broken black tea.

Three more lines followed in 2003, taking annual output and sales to about 2,500 tons, according to an account of the company's development. It is suited to blending and sold in bags.
